item.title: PyPad 1.7.9-prerelease
item.description: - HTML export now preserves markdown structure as real HTML elements (headings/lists/links/code). - Added Demo Pack markdown templates under File > Templates > Demo Pack (new + insert actions). - Added Help > Open Demo Pack (first template) one-click launcher. - First-time tutorial now recommends trying the Demo Pack. - Big plugins update! The plugins system has been refactored and improved, and all plugins have been updated to be compatible with the latest PyPad version. This includes: - New plugin API for better performance and stability. - Various bug fixes and performance improvements across the app. - Detailed changelog: CHANGELOG.md
